title: IACS UR Z7, Z18 and Z20 custody repair - two shipped corrections and a sub-paragraph-level card rested on sources that were never held, hashed or registered, and one of them was a superseded revision read from a third-party reprint
candidate_claim: Founder/GPT ruling attached to Tranche 3: do NOT acquire only UR Z20; close the directly observed Z-series custody gap for UR Z7, UR Z18 and UR Z20, and do not expand to every IACS Unified Requirement. Verify every UR Z20 paragraph the affected card cites, and for Z7 and Z18 verify only the propositions the corpus already relies on.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD AND CLOSED, WITH ZERO CONTENT MISMATCHES - which is the result that makes the custody gap worth recording rather than the result that excuses it. The corpus was RIGHT on every proposition, but it was right on evidence nobody could re-derive: CORR-CSM-BOILER-SURVEY-20260823 cites 'IACS UR Z18 ... Rev.8 2018, read in full from the Turk Loydu published copy' - a SUPERSEDED revision read from a third-party reprint - and CORR-URZ7-20260901 cites a consolidated 2024 PDF outside the repository with no hash and no registry row. Neither could be re-verified by a later session, and the Rev.8 citation would have read as current forever. All three URs have now been retrieved from IACS itself, hash-pinned and registered, and every relied-on proposition re-verified against the CURRENT revision. NO CANDIDATE-FACING TEXT NEEDED TO CHANGE.

authority.acquisition_method: PUBLISHER-ANCHORED, not supersession-anchored. IACS's own resolutions library was queried for EVERY UR Z7 / Z18 / Z20 record it publishes - not for the revision the corpus already believed in - and each record's own currency flag and its future-publication fields were read. Asking 'is Rev.8 still current?' would have returned an answer about Rev.8; asking 'what does IACS publish as current today?' is what surfaced Rev.9.

EVERY ONE was read against the held Rev.2 and EVERY ONE MATCHES: 1.1.1-1.1.4 (alternative to CMS; maker's intervals, documented operator experience, condition monitoring where fitted; limited to components covered by CMS; items outside surveyed in the usual way); 1.2.1 (intervals not exceeding CMS, longer for running-hours items on maker's recommendation); 1.3.1, 1.3.2 and 1.3.3 - the card QUOTES 1.3.1 verbatim and the quote is exact; 2.1.1-2.1.3; 2.2.1's six documents and 2.2.2's four categories, both counts correct, and the card's parenthetical that the UR prints 'filling' for 'filing' is itself correct; 2.3.1 including the 'however' limb and 'in any case the certification is to be kept on board'; 2.3.2, 2.3.3, 2.3.4; 2.3.5's three cancellation grounds; 2.3.6; 2.3.7; 3.1.1's one year from date of approval; 3.1.2's three verifications; 3.1.3; 3.2.1's 'preferably concurrently'; 3.2.2. The stated revision 'Rev.2, May 2019' is also correct. NO CONTENT REWRITE WAS NEEDED and none was made.
authority.z18_proposition_verification: Only the propositions already relied on, per the brief. CORR-CSM-BOILER-SURVEY-20260823 relied on: 1.3 Continuous Surveys with a 5-year interval between consecutive examinations - MATCHES Rev.9; section 2 'Survey of Steam Boilers' as a structurally separate section - MATCHES; 2.1's minimum two internal examinations per 5-year special survey period and 36-month maximum interval, with the listed applicability thresholds 0.35 N/mm2 and 4.5 m2 - MATCHES, and Rev.9 adds a 3-month extension limb the correction did not rely on; 2.2's annual external survey with testing of safety and protective devices - MATCHES, and Rev.9 adds the exhaust-gas-economizer safety-valve test by the Chief Engineer, which the card does not claim. CORR-URZ7-20260901 relied on the section list 1.3 / 1.5 / 1.6 and on Rev.9 Apr 2020 - both MATCH. The Rev.8 to Rev.9 delta does not touch any relied-on proposition.
authority.z7_proposition_verification: Relied on: the title is 'Hull Classification Surveys' - MATCHES; it has no machinery content - MATCHES, the contents page runs General, Special, Annual and Intermediate Survey, Preparation for survey, four thickness-measurement tables and two annexes; and 'Z7 is hull' as taught in QB1_F#q23, QB1_supplementary#q4 and QB1_FG_CheatSheet - MATCHES. Additionally established for the record: UR Z7.1 is 'Hull surveys for general dry cargo ships' and UR Z7.2 is 'Hull surveys for liquefied gas carriers'.

The held UR Z7 is 'Hull Classification Surveys'; UR Z7.1 is 'Hull surveys for general dry cargo ships' and UR Z7.2 is 'Hull surveys for liquefied gas carriers'; the ESP requirements for bulk carriers and oil tankers are the UR Z10 series. This is the SAME defect CORR-URZ7-20260901 fixed in QB1_supplementary, surviving in a card that correction's sweep did not reach - its sweep was filtered to hits mentioning machinery, CMS, CSM or continuous, and QB4_E's hits mention none of those. The brief scopes Z7 verification to 'the propositions already relied on by current candidate-facing content/corrections' and QB4_E is not a Z7-corrected card, and it forbids a general IACS audit. REPORTED to GPT as the highest-priority carry-forward of this family. A filtered sweep is not a sweep, and that is the reusable lesson.
QB1_E teaches 'UR Z7 for dry cargo ships', which is strictly UR Z7.1. Defensible as a family reference and not corrected. REPORTED.
UR Z27 (Condition Monitoring / CBM) is cited by QB1_F#q23 and was NOT acquired. The brief expressly bounded acquisition to Z7, Z18 and Z20. Carried forward.

why_this_is_not_a_correction_manifest: IT CHANGES NO CANDIDATE-FACING BYTE, so there is no q-card to pin. A correction manifest asserts pre/post digests of a q-card block; docs/sources/MIW_SOURCE_REGISTRY.json has no q-card, and card_digests() returns {} for it. Filing this as correction_*_manifest.json would have turned validate_corrections.py red on every run - correctly - because the record would be claiming to own a card that does not exist. It is a SEPARATE coherent family, as the brief required, recorded in the form that matches what it actually did: source custody moved from not-held to held-and-hash-pinned. Its assertions are enforced by the content gate in tools/oral/validate_correction_gptt3c.py, exactly as known_traps.md is in CORR-GPT-T2A-GRAIN-20260905.
